summary.text: Leanne Harple is a Democratic state representative from Orleans-4 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A teacher by profession, she was born in Glover, Vermont.

paragraphs.text: Leanne Harple earned a bachelor's degree and a master's degree from Johnson State College.
Her career experience includes working as a teacher.
Harple assumed office in the Vermont House on January 8, 2025, succeeding Katherine Sims.
